cases.case_label: Exonic LINE-1 insertion in CC2D2A (Meckel syndrome)
cases.mechanism_detail: An exonic L1 insertion (detected with TEMP2) is in trans with a deep-intronic CC2D2A variant; disruption of coding sequence is presumed from the exonic location, and CC2D2A protein was markedly reduced.
cases.quote: Here we report a Japanese girl with Meckel syndrome harboring a pathogenic deep intronic variant (NM_001378615.1:c.1149+3569A>G) and an exonic LINE-1 insertion
